transcript.text: sure. so most of the quotes are in, uh, the machined brackets came back from two vendors, one is a lot faster

transcript.speaker: p-talia

transcript.text: Good. Anything on lead times for the machine shop?

transcript.speaker: p-gwen

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
